layout.hierarchy: Title dominates at top in large bold text. Class headers 'Positive Class' and 'Negative Class' are colored and medium-sized. Diagram boxes on right are secondary. Body text and repeated labels are smallest.

visual_elements.description: Training flowchart box with red header 'Training'. Left to right: 'Input Sample' text with right arrow into red 'Model' box containing '[Any value] -> (-1, +1)' and purple sigmoid icon. Right arrow to 'Predicted Class' text. Right arrow to orange circle labeled 'LOSS'. Right arrow to 'Label of Input Sample (+1, 0)'. A mouse cursor arrow points at the Model box from the left.

Evaluation flowchart box with red header 'Evaluation'. Left to right: 'Test Sample' text with right arrow into red 'Model' box containing '[Any value] -> (-1, +1)' and purple sigmoid icon. Right arrow to 'Predicted Class' text. Right arrow to blue text '(+1, 0)'.
Sigmoid curve graph inside Activation Function box. Purple S-shaped curve on light background with axes visible.
Five black-and-white line drawing airplanes in red-bordered box (Positive Class). Each plane has a small skull/crossbones or enemy marking.
Five black-and-white line drawing airplanes in green-bordered box (Negative Class). These appear to be civilian/passenger planes without enemy markings.
Red rectangular border around Positive Class airplane images.
Green rectangular border around Negative Class airplane images.
Red vertical column with five '+1' text entries aligned with positive class planes.
Green vertical column with five '0' text entries aligned with negative class planes.

imagery: Ten airplane line drawings total: five 'enemy' planes with skull markings in Positive Class panel, five 'safe' passenger planes in Negative Class panel. All are simple black outline illustrations on white background.
Purple sigmoid curve icon inside Model boxes and larger version in Activation Function box.
Mouse cursor arrow pointing at Training Model box.
typography_notes: Sans-serif font throughout. Title is large and bold. Class headers 'Positive Class' (red) and 'Negative Class' (green) are bold and colored. Quoted subtitles 'Shoot the Enemy' and 'Safe' appear in italics or emphasized style. Repeated labels (+1, 0) are in colored boxes. Diagram text is black sans-serif.

recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with light gray background (#f0f0f0). 2. Add a full-width white title bar at top with blue border; type 'Training Samples with Labels [0,1] (Two Classes)' in bold black sans-serif. 3. Add a circle with '2' in top-right corner. 4. On the left half, create two side-by-side panels: left panel red-bordered titled 'Positive Class' with subtitle '"Shoot the Enemy"' and column header 'Label'; place 5 enemy airplane drawings vertically inside; to its right add a red column with five '+1' entries. 5. Next panel green-bordered titled 'Negative Class' with subtitle '"Safe"' and column header 'Label'; place 5 passenger airplane drawings vertically inside; to its right add a green column with five '0' entries. 6. On the right half, top: box titled 'Activation Function' with text 'Sigmoid function (0 , +1)', 'Threshold at "0.5"', and a sigmoid curve graph. 7. Middle right: box titled 'Training' in red; draw flowchart Input Sample -> Model ([Any value] -> (-1, +1) with sigmoid icon) -> Predicted Class -> orange LOSS circle -> Label of Input Sample (+1, 0); add mouse cursor arrow pointing at Model. 8. Bottom right: box titled 'Evaluation' in red; draw flowchart Test Sample -> Model ([Any value] -> (-1, +1) with sigmoid icon) -> Predicted Class -> blue text (+1, 0). 9. Use accents: red #c0392b, green #2ecc71, orange #f39c12, blue #2980b9, purple #8e44ad.
